The major's 44 units are printed as the Required Core block total ('Required Core: (44 Units)'); no separate major total is printed, so total_units is null.
Recommended prior experience (one year of automotive education, e.g., AUTO 50 series) is not a course list and was not recorded as a block.
Text at the top of page 63 (AUTO 99A-99F, 90 units) belongs to a different program and was ignored; the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced section was also ignored.
The description names 'an entry-level position in the automotive repair industry in engine diagnostics'; no specific career title is named, so careers is empty.
